markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set [F1], but the MUSK model disagrees and only 2 of 5 neighbors match.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 94%, InSitu 5% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models split on top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign [F5] | Neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; pulls concept model away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Score above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Score low; slightly lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 0, 10) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable [F3].

## Could be wrong if
- The image is blur-degraded (severity 3), and the MUSK model picks a different top class.
- Reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87); 0.99 is not a guarantee.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2**: highest per-region invasive risk (up to 10%); look for stromal infiltration.
2. **Region 5**: top region for the duct-confined concept (Weak); InSitu is 5%.
3. **Region 8**: judge nuclear atypia; pleomorphism concept peaks here (Validated).
